positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Aortic valve (AV) experiences a complex mechanical environment, which differs on either sides of the valve. Alterations in this mechanical environment could lead to pathological remodeling of the valve, thus causing AV disease. The overall aim of this research is to improve the current understanding of AV pathogenesis by analyzing the role of altered hemodynamics in mediating aortic valve inflammation and calcification.

publications.publisher: The 6th Biennial Heart Valve Biology & Tissue Engineering Meeting · Sep 1, 2014
